# Hub API compatibility matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/hub-matrix.py from compat/hf/compatibility-matrix.json. Do not edit; run `make generate`. -->

Every Hugging Face Hub endpoint that `huggingface_hub` and the libraries built on it call, and whether Hangar serves it. The compatibility suite in `compat/hf` writes this table from its own results, so every row marked supported is covered by a passing test against real clients.

Tested with `huggingface_hub` 2.2.0: 65 endpoints supported and 4 not supported.

| Endpoint | Status | Covered by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/collections` | Supported | `test_collections` |  |
| `POST /api/collections` | Supported | `test_collections` |  |
| `DELETE /api/collections/{slug}` | Supported | `test_collections` |  |
| `GET /api/collections/{slug}` | Supported | `test_collections` |  |
| `PATCH /api/collections/{slug}` | Supported | `test_collections` |  |
| `POST /api/collections/{slug}/items` | Supported | `test_collections` |  |
| `DELETE /api/collections/{slug}/items/{id}` | Supported | `test_collections` |  |
| `PATCH /api/collections/{slug}/items/{id}` | Supported | `test_collections` |  |
| `GET /api/datasets` | Supported | `test_list_models_and_datasets` |  |
| `GET /api/datasets/{repo}` | Supported | `test_create_repo_variants` |  |
| `GET /api/models` | Supported | `test_list_models_and_datasets` |  |
| `GET /api/models/{repo}` | Supported | `test_create_repo_variants`, `test_model_info_shape` |  |
| `GET /api/models/{repo}/revision/{rev}` | Supported | `test_exists_checks` |  |
| `POST /api/repos/create` | Supported | `test_create_repo_variants` |  |
| `DELETE /api/repos/delete` | Supported | `test_delete_repo`, `test_write_token_administers_own_repos` |  |
| `POST /api/repos/move` | Supported | `test_move_repo_redirects` |  |
| `/api/spaces/...` | Not supported | - | Spaces are out of scope. |
| `GET /api/users/{user}/likes` | Supported | `test_likers_and_liked_repos` |  |
| `POST /api/validate-yaml` | Supported | `test_upload_file_and_folder` |  |
| `GET /api/whoami-v2` | Supported | `test_whoami` |  |
| `GET /api/whoami-v2 (hf auth)` | Supported | `test_hf_auth_login_and_whoami` |  |
| `DELETE /api/{type}s/{repo}/branch/{branch}` | Supported | `test_branches_and_tags` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/branch/{branch}` | Supported | `test_branches_and_tags` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/commit/{rev}` | Supported | `test_create_commit_adds_deletes_copies`, `test_upload_file_and_folder`, `test_upload_large_file_round_trip`, `test_upload_many_files`, `test_upload_of_an_object_stored_in_another_users_private_repo`, `test_upload_over_multipart_threshold` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/commit/{rev}?create_pr=1` | Supported | `test_failed_create_pr_commit_opens_no_pull_request`, `test_hf_upload_to_new_branch_and_pr` |  |
| `GET /api/{type}s/{repo}/commits/{rev}` | Supported | `test_list_repo_commits` |  |
| `GET /api/{type}s/{repo}/discussions` | Supported | `test_discussions_and_pull_requests`, `test_failed_create_pr_commit_opens_no_pull_request` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/discussions` | Supported | `test_discussions_and_pull_requests` |  |
| `GET /api/{type}s/{repo}/discussions/{num}` | Supported | `test_discussions_and_pull_requests`, `test_hf_upload_to_new_branch_and_pr` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/discussions/{num}/comment` | Supported | `test_discussions_and_pull_requests` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/discussions/{num}/comment/{id}/edit` | Supported | `test_edit_and_hide_comments` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/discussions/{num}/comment/{id}/hide` | Supported | `test_edit_and_hide_comments` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/discussions/{num}/merge` | Supported | `test_discussions_and_pull_requests` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/discussions/{num}/status` | Supported | `test_discussions_and_pull_requests` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/discussions/{num}/title` | Supported | `test_discussions_and_pull_requests` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/lfs-files/duplicate` | Not supported | - | Cross-Repo LFS copy needs Xet hashes. Copies within a Repo work. |
| `DELETE /api/{type}s/{repo}/like` | Supported | `test_unlike` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/like` | Supported | `test_likers_and_liked_repos`, `test_unlike` |  |
| `GET /api/{type}s/{repo}/likers` | Supported | `test_likers_and_liked_repos` |  |

| `GET /api/{type}s/{repo}/refs` | Supported | `test_branches_and_tags` |  |
| `GET /api/{type}s/{repo}/revision/{rev}` | Supported | `test_exists_checks`, `test_snapshot_download_and_offline` |  |
| `PUT /api/{type}s/{repo}/settings` | Supported | `test_update_repo_settings`, `test_write_token_administers_own_repos` |  |
| `POST /api/{type}s/{repo}/tag/{rev}` | Supported | `test_branches_and_tags` |  |
| `DELETE /api/{type}s/{repo}/tag/{tag}` | Supported | `test_branches_and_tags` |  |
| `GET /api/{type}s/{repo}/tree/{rev}/{path}` | Supported | `test_snapshot_download_and_offline`, `test_tree_and_paths_info` |  |
| `GET /api/{type}s/{repo}/xet-read-token/{rev}` | Not supported | - | Hangar never offers Xet downloads; downloads use plain HTTP. |
| `GET /api/{type}s/{repo}/xet-write-token/{rev}` | Supported | `test_upload_large_file_round_trip`, `test_xet_write_token` |  |
| `POST /{repo}.git/info/lfs/objects/batch` | Supported | `test_upload_file_and_folder`, `test_upload_of_an_object_stored_in_another_users_private_repo` |  |
| `POST /{repo}.git/info/lfs/objects/batch (basic, presigned MinIO URL, no Xet)` | Supported | `TestHubBasicUploadToMinIOWithoutXet` |  |
| `POST /{repo}.git/info/lfs/objects/batch (multipart)` | Supported | `test_upload_over_multipart_threshold` |  |
| `GET /{repo}/resolve/{rev}/{path}` | Supported | `test_hf_hub_download_by_revision` |  |
| `HEAD /{repo}/resolve/{rev}/{path}` | Supported | `test_hf_hub_download_by_revision` |  |
| `GET /{repo}/resolve/{rev}/{path} (Range)` | Supported | `test_ranges_and_safetensors_metadata` |  |
| `GET /{repo}/resolve/{rev}/{path} (no Xet)` | Supported | `test_download_with_hf_xet_installed` |  |
| `GET /{repo}/resolve/{rev}/{path} (resume)` | Supported | `test_resume_partial_download` |  |
| `HfFileSystem` | Supported | `test_datasets_load_dataset`, `test_hf_file_system` |  |
| `/api/jobs/... and /api/inference/...` | Not supported | - | Jobs and the Inference API are out of scope. |
| `hf download` | Supported | `test_hf_download_and_upload` |  |
| `redirects for moved Repos` | Supported | `test_move_repo_redirects` |  |
| `transformers from_pretrained` | Supported | `test_transformers_auto_classes` |  |
| `sentence-transformers load` | Supported | `test_sentence_transformers` |  |
| `datasets load_dataset` | Supported | `test_datasets_load_dataset` |  |
| `error mapping` | Supported | `test_gated_repo`, `test_not_found_errors`, `test_private_repos_are_hidden` |  |
| `permissions` | Supported | `test_write_permissions` |  |
| `transformers safetensors conversion guard` | Supported | `test_pickle_only_model_never_contacts_conversion_space` |  |
| `bad token` | Supported | `test_bad_token` |  |
| `hf upload` | Supported | `test_hf_download_and_upload` |  |

Spaces, the Inference API, Hugging Face Jobs, Buckets and kernels, SSH git and Xet downloads are out of scope; see [What it is not](../index.md#what-it-is-not).
